Everything is well-done and fluid, from the titan controls, multiplayer balancing, getting in and out of your titan and fighting alongside it, wallrunning and jetpacks. I give it a lot of credit for the momentum based movement system Black Ops 3 now employs. Also "you have joined a losing team, a loss will not be recorded" is a nice touch. Some games impress me with their ambition, but Titanfall impressed me by staying inside its wheelhouse and simply doing everything right.

Is it better to use the lazy newb pack and dwarf psychiatrist or just play it raw? I tried to get into it a couple of times, but couldn't understand it.

Lazy newb pack. Dwarf Therapist is a must, and i prefer the Ironhand tileset. Therapist will let you control your dwarves labors all at once, and sort them easily many ways. Also, it is imperative you have a Proficient Weaponsmith,and a Proficient Cook, these two should ideally working round the clock. Weaponsmith makes serrated blades (high value,also great for traps) and Cook makes Lavish meals which use up a lot of your food stores,but make dwarves very happy,and are also ubervalueable in trading.

Also have someone be a designated Stonecrafter and have them crafting rock pots forever. Pots hold more than barrels,but weigh more. This is so you dont clearcut all your trees to make barrels for beer.

And finally, Bridges can let you capture megabeasts. Once they are drawn up they are considered walls and cannot be broken by megabeasts. I also like putting a hatch in the capture rooms ceiling so I can dump my endless store of goblins in cages. Its great watching a solitary goblin with no armor or weapons punching and kicking a 30ft flying steel lobster with deadly dust clouds until they get squashed or die of horrible disease.

Edit: and use the wiki! It is absolutely essential you use the wiki!
